relationships.subject: PRICKLE1
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings demonstrate that Prickle1 loss in the myometrium results in a UL phenotype characterized by altered collagen expression, excessive ECM deposition, aberrant smooth muscle cell organization, increased Esr1 and Pgr expression and dysregulated Wnt/PCP signaling.

key_findings: Myometrial Prickle1 loss yields a uterine leiomyoma-like phenotype with aberrant ECM
